opportunities.point: A chemicals tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
Demand for gelatin in the nutraceutical and pharmaceutical sectors is driven by growing awareness of its health benefits.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Gelatin, being a rich source of collagen, is recognised for boosting joint health, skin elasticity, and hair strength, driving its demand in the nutraceutical and pharmaceutical sectors." (annual report - 2024-03-31)

opportunities.point: The demand for medicines is expected to increase due to the rapid growth of the ageing population globally.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Owing to the rapid growth of the ageing population across the world, the demand for medicines is expected to increase." (annual report - 2024-03-31)

opportunities.point: Sales volume of gelatine and DCP decreased by 5% and 8% respectively.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Sales volume of gelatine / DCP decreased by 5%/ 8%." (annual report - 2024-03-31)

opportunities.point: Free cash flow is positive and improving, funding growth without fresh debt.

Historically strong quarters (Mar, Dec) are still in the cycle.

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
The rise of plant-based gelatin substitutes is a primary market barrier.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The rise of plant-based gelatin substitutes, fueled by rising demand for vegetarian and vegan goods, is one of the primary market barriers." (annual report - 2024-03-31)

threats.point: Traditional gelatin made from animal sources is threatened by the trend toward sustainable and ethical alternatives.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Traditional gelatin made from animal sources is in danger due to this trend, as consumers look for alternatives that take sustainability and ethics into account." (annual report - 2024-03-31)

threats.point: Sourcing good quality crushed bones, the main raw material, is a major concern.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The availability of our main raw material, i.e. crushed bones, is a cause of concern The difficulty in sourcing good quality raw material is a major issue." (annual report - 2024-03-31)

threats.point: Small size brings liquidity and volatility risk.
Historically weak quarters (Jun, Sep) are still in the cycle.
